text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—This is Kiseki's!! Winning panel, 
goooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Running away, running away, running away! 
Kiseki puts on an unbelievable display! 
Can the chasers even keep up!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaaa!?" "Kiseki is amazing...!" "She's 
definitely gonna get overtaken at the 
wire." "...No, wait." "Could it be...?" 
"—No way!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
No way... She's not going to lead 
wire-to-wire, is she—?!
choice_data_list: (...Ghk, but even so, Ai can...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! —I wanna win, I wanna 
win... I wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win!!!!

In the next moment—Almond Eye blew right 
past the tenaciously holding Kiseki in the 
blink of an eye. And then...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah!? What is that acceleration?! 
She's flying...!!
choice_data_list: Go... Eye!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye!!!! Japan Cup champion! 
Unbelievable strength... She is truly 
unbeatable...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did it…………!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A victory by a Classic-year Tiara 
Umamusume—a historic feat second only to 
Gentildonna!! Just how far will this 
Umamusume's strength go...!
choice_data_list: (How far will this go...—?)

text_block_list.text: ââTo the ends of the earth.

Ever since we first met, her running 
has... never stopped improving. I'm 
certain she can grow stronger—limitlessly 
so.
choice_data_list:
(Ai—she can surpass everything from the 
past.)

text_block_list.text:
Illuminated by her, the dream has now... 
taken on a distinct, tangible shape.

—I want to leave it behind. Just like the 
legendary Umamusume of the past—no, with a 
trail of light even more dazzling... I 
want to engrave the name Almond Eye...!
choice_data_list: (This is my—greatest job yet.)
(This is my—greatest job!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...It was supposed to be the runaway 
victory of the century...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It hurts... It's so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was the one who got thrilled...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan. You're... not the protagonist. 
You're far too dazzling... far too strong 
to be relatable.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—The one who defeats you is the 
protagonist. In that case... I'll become 
that protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Nice going, Ai!
You did it, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Kiseki-chan and everyone else were so 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But you know! I strongly wanted to win... 
and just like that, I actually won!
choice_data_list: You were so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, right?! Next time too, I'll...――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Your eyes are sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're thinking about something, 
aren't you? —About me!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Our dream just got even bigger.
Yeah. My dream has grown even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...! That sounds wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I keep on winning, will it really come 
true?!
choice_data_list: No...

text_block_list.text:
Simply being "strong" won't leave a mark 
for eternity. I must stand alongside those 
hailed as the "strongest"— no, I must 
surpass their achievements.
choice_data_list:
(First, I have to figure out what that 
is.)

text_block_list.text:
"In the back of my mind, there's always 
something I anticipate. However, if it's 
not worthy of 'Almond Eye', it won't 
become an achievement etched in people's 
hearts."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...OK! We'll decide on our next target 
race after we've sorted through our 
feelings!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll leave it to you. Once you're 
ready—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting at the starting line!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer! What is Ai's next move?! As a 
Triple Tiara Umamusume, will she be 
seeking even greater glory?!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her performance today, her 
potential is limitless! A path no one has 
ever carved before— even the world stage 
is within her reach!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Will you walk the royal road in the Senior 
Class after all?! To reign over this era 
as the new pinnacle of the racing 
world...!

The crowded reporters excitedly discuss 
what form Almond Eye's next great 
achievement will take—and each of their 
visions feels subtly different.
choice_data_list: (――None of that is "Ai's" achievement.)

text_block_list.text:
The "strongest" Umamusume I have 
encountered so far. Each with their own 
unique strength, they achieved feats that 
were entirely their own.

—Strength born from shattering common 
sense.

—Strength born from an obsession with 
being the strongest.
—Strength born of a lofty perspective.
choice_data_list: (――None of that is "Ai's" strength.)

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's strength... And the shape of 
the historic feat that will etch her name 
into history is...
choice_data_list: （……Huh? What's that—）

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ai, isn't today your rest day? Why 
are you here?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm watching. The girls adjusting, the 
girls on the uphill, the girls training 
side-by-side... I'm watching everyone.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Ai really is so devoted to 
studying.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, it's more like... I just want to think 
about how to win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With every minute, every second I stand 
still... someone out there is getting 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"—If the current me is going to beat 
them... I need to figure out what it'll 
take!"
choice_data_list:
(...Winning is always all that's on her 
mind.)

(...Winning is always all that's on her 
mind.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But you know! I strongly wanted to win... 
and just like that, I actually won!
choice_data_list: (――I see. It was actually so simple.)
(――Right, it was actually so simple.)

text_block_list.text:
Normally, things wouldn't go so smoothly. 
Yet she always takes on the challenge and 
always produces results.

"Being able to win when you want to win"— 
That is Almond Eye's greatest strength. 
—Her power that surpasses all the 
strongest.
choice_data_list: (So it really does lead... "here.")

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Trainer...
choice_data_list: Ai, got it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Then, will you tell me? What must be 
done for your dream to come true?
choice_data_list:
We will win every single race you want to 
win.
I'll win every race you want to win.

text_block_list.text:
However, it won't be an ordinary race. A 
GⅠ race like the Japan Cup... We're 
setting our sights on the pinnacle—

Her route doesn't matter. She will simply 
win as her heart desires— winning 
endlessly, for as far as she can go.
choice_data_list:
The record for most turf G1 wins — a feat 
so befitting of you

The record for most turf G1 wins — a feat 
so befitting of you

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps you've wanted to see that all 
along, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Winning the races I want to win is what 
I've wanted to do all along.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With every repetition, your victories will 
pile up. —And your dream will come true as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Chasing different dreams, yet feeling the 
same joy. Isn't that just so like us?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Very well. For our Senior year... let's 
win, win, and keep on winning!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's win race after race!
Yeah, let's win a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. When you put it into words, it 
sounds kind of broad... or rather, simple!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm so happy! I get to run so much, 
after all.
choice_data_list:
It might end up being a tough rotation, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You won't give up, you won't 
compromise... You'll bring out the 
absolute best in me, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Then it'll be fine! Have you already 
decided on your first goal?"
choice_data_list: First, how about the Osaka Hai?
First, what do you think of the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.text:
The race to determine the strongest 
Umamusume of the spring medium-distance 
division— At Almond Eye's optimal 
distance, her challenge toward a legendary 
feat begins.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go with the Osaka Hai! That 
way we can race sooner.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—This is the starting point for the two of 
us.

Breaking records that even the strongest 
of the past could not surpass, claiming a 
brilliant victory—
choice_data_list:
(I'll make the future we dreamed of that 
day... a reality!)

text_block_list.text:
A future where everyone aims for Almond 
Eye's records— let's create that future.
